question: What is the total net revenue per market segment?
gold_sql: SELECT c.c_mktsegment, ROUND(SUM(l.l_net_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
pred_sql:
SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(CAST(l.l_net_revenue AS REAL)) AS total_net_revenue
FROM customer AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment
ORDER BY total_net_revenue DESC

question: Which nations have the highest number of customers?
gold_sql: SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(*) AS num_customers FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY num_customers DESC LIMIT 10
pred_sql:
SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(c.c_custkey) AS customer_count
FROM nation AS n
JOIN customer AS c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name
ORDER BY customer_count DESC

question: What is the average discount applied per supplier nation?
gold_sql: SELECT n.n_name, ROUND(AVG(l.l_discount), 4) AS avg_discount FROM lineitem l JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY avg_discount DESC
pred_sql:
SELECT n.n_name, AVG(CAST(l.l_discount AS REAL)) AS avg_discount
FROM lineitem AS l
JOIN supplier AS s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation AS n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name
ORDER BY n.n_name

question: List the top 10 suppliers by total quantity supplied.
gold_sql: SELECT s.s_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM supplier s JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 10
pred_sql:
SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(CAST(l.l_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_quantity
FROM supplier AS s
JOIN lineitem AS l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 10

question: What is the total revenue by order quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT o.o_quarter, ROUND(SUM(l.l_net_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_quarter ORDER BY o.o_quarter
pred_sql:
SELECT o_quarter, SUM(CAST(l_net_revenue AS REAL)) AS total_revenue
FROM orders AS T1
JOIN lineitem AS T2 ON T1.o_orderkey = T2.l_orderkey
GROUP BY o_quarter
ORDER BY o_quarter

question: Which part types generate the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT p.p_type, ROUND(SUM(l.l_net_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_type ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
pred_sql:
SELECT p.p_type, SUM(CAST(l.l_extendedprice AS REAL) * (1 - CAST(l.l_discount AS REAL))) AS total_revenue
FROM lineitem AS l
JOIN part AS p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
GROUP BY p.p_type
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

question: What is the average order value per customer balance tier?
gold_sql: SELECT c.c_has_debt, ROUND(AVG(o.o_totalprice), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_has_debt ORDER BY c.c_has_debt
pred_sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(c_acctbal AS REAL) < 0 THEN 'Negative Balance'
        WHEN CAST(c_acctbal AS REAL) >= 0 AND CAST(c_acctbal AS REAL) < 2500 THEN 'Low (0-2500)'
        WHEN CAST(c_acctbal AS REAL) >= 2500 AND CAST(c_acctbal AS REAL) < 5000 THEN 'Medium (2500-5000)'
        WHEN CAST(c_acctbal AS REAL) >= 5000 AND CAST(c_acctbal AS REAL) < 7500 THEN 'High (5000-7500)'
        ELSE 'Very High (7500+)'
    END AS balance_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(o.o_totalprice AS REAL)), 2) AS avg_order_value,
    ROUND(SUM(CAST(o.o_totalprice AS REAL)) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey), 2) AS avg_order_value_per_customer
FROM customer AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
GROUP BY balance_tier
ORDER BY MIN(CAST(c_acctbal AS REAL));

question: Which regions have the highest total lineitem quantity?
gold_sql: SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC
pred_sql:
SELECT r.r_name, SUM(CAST(l.l_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_quantity
FROM lineitem AS l
JOIN orders AS o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer AS c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation AS n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region AS r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
